Every signal around a detected serve

A serve is called when two bounces land on opposite sides of the net within 1.6s, the ball rises between them, and it never travels backwards. 41% of what that finds is not a serve. Red blocks below are wrong calls, green are right ones, for comparison.

Splitting the 181 wrong calls by what is happening at that moment: 70% fire in dead time with no point anywhere near, 25% fire inside a real rally, 5% just outside one. The mid-rally case is the one that split point 13; it is not the common one.
